nodes.label: desktop memory - the project overview as the desktop recorded it

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Post-thesis Graph-RAG work. The repo is now just v3/ - a lean, self-contained HERB evaluation harness, with v1/ and v2/ deleted 2026-06-23 and their source surviving in git history, and the artefact arm rebuilt natively inside v3. The harness compares three answer-producing arms on HERB - artefact, lucene and vector - scored by RAGAS ONLY: HERB is the benchmark DATASET and there is NO separate HERB scorer, the old HERB-plus-RAGAS framing being dead and not to be reintroduced from stale docs, with RAGAS including the judge-free id-based context precision and recall as the headline retrieval signal. The artefact is the system under test; lucene (BM25) and vector (dense) are baselines, each with its own index over the corpus; and arms share only the corpus on disk plus the injected generator. Design reference v3/README.md.
